text:
Ada: quick check — can we run a 7-day headroom forecast for all regions? want to call out any clusters < 10% spare GPU capacity by monday morning
Miguel: pulling numbers now, give me 2m
Miguel: us-west1 (cluster-a): baseline 6,200 GPUh/day, expected +18% from campaign -> need ~1,116 GPUh extra/day. spare headroom today ~9% if no burst added.
Priya: eu-central (cluster-b) is weird — egress flaps yesterday added ~40ms p50 on inter-zone copies, throughput dropped ~7% for short windows. that eats batch density.
Ben: that explains the higher per-token cost we saw on the eval runs. if batch density drops we lose ~12% efficiency on the same instance mix.
Ada: ok — actionables: 1) estimate cost for reserving temporary burst nodes in us-west1, 2) mitigation for eu-central network jitter, 3) schedule APAC maintenance impact check.
Sasha: APAC (apac-sg1) ops-bot already queued a small maintenance window today at 2200 UTC. ops-bot: reminder: scheduled maintenance on apac-sg1 from 2026-03-18T22:00Z to 2026-03-19T01:00Z — will drain one rack (r12).
Miguel: quick table (approx):
```
region | cluster   | baseline GPUh/day | forecast delta | spare %
us-west1| cluster-a | 6200             | +18%           | 9%
eu-central| cluster-b | 4400           | +6%            | 5%
apac-sg1| cluster-c | 2100             | +12%           | 14%
```
Priya: eu-central spare 5% is dangerous given the egress jitter — recommend temporary 3 node add (A100), or move some heavy batch reranks to us-west for next 48h.
Ben: cost for 3 x A100 on reserved burst (30h) ~= $3.6k. On spot it's ~ $1.1k but risk of preemptions affecting latency SLO.
Ada: prioritize SLOs — avoid spot for routing-critical endpoints. for batch reranks we can use spot. split traffic: critical -> reserved burst, batch -> spot.
Sasha: also flag: net team scheduling a firmware update for eu central TORs tomorrow 03:00Z — might cause transient packet drops during reconvergence.
Miguel: added a quick query to the capacity dashboard to pull 95p latency vs batch density:
```
select region, cluster, p95_latency_ms, avg_batch_size from perf_metrics where ts > now() - interval '24 hours' and model_family = 'inference' order by region;
```
Miguel: current p95 in eu-central jumped 42ms -> 98ms in the 03:40–03:55 slot yesterday. avg_batch_size dropped from 12 -> 9.
Priya: propose mitigation: enable prefix KV caching for the 4 top customers hitting eu cluster (30% of load) — should lower KV miss amplification and restore batch density.
Ben: if caching reduces miss rate by 25% we regain ~6% efficiency; cost of transient cache memory is negligible.
Ada: can we get a 48h plan by EOD? please include: estimated extra GPUh, cost delta, impact to p50/p95, and rollback plan.
Sasha: I'll draft maintenance/comms note for APAC and the net team update for EU. adding runbook links: https://console.redwood.example/ops/runbooks/drain-rack and https://console.redwood.example/capacity/forecast
Priya: quick note — schedule a canary to migrate 10% of eu traffic to us-west for 1h tomorrow 04:30Z to validate routing and cost impact.
Miguel: will run forecast with the canary baked in and post numbers in this thread when done (ETA 90m).
Ada: thanks — if anyone sees >12% tail cost increase tag me. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: deploy-bot: canary scheduled by Miguel for 2026-03-19T04:30Z (10% traffic, 1h).
Ben: one final item — check spot reclaim behavior on our multi-tenant pools. if reclaim spikes we should circuit-break noncritical jobs earlier.
Ada: agreed. end of quick readout. keep updates short in this thread.
